text: Welcome, traveller. Rest beneath the trees, and let the evening bring you peace.
instruction: A noble adult male elf with a refined light baritone, smooth warm resonance, clear diction and courtly dignity. Poised, serene and quietly authoritative, speaking with gentle musical phrasing at a natural measured pace. An elegant British English accent. Spoken dialogue, not singing; no breathy whisper, growl, gravel, dramatic trailer voice or background sound.
